generic.Defined scope/population: Total adjusted capital and authorized control level RBC for the group as of the current quarter-end.
generic.In-scope period: Current quarter-end, compared to the prior quarter's filed ratio.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: TAC, ACL, RBC ratio, and as-of date populated with non-null model run values.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Calculated RBC ratio (TAC/ACL) matches the actuarial model's own ratio output.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Capital adequacy assessment workpaper retained with the as-of date and model run version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any RBC ratio movement over 10 points versus prior quarter logged with driver in the workpaper.
generic.Test population: The current-quarter capital adequacy assessment workpaper and underlying RBC model run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: RBC ratio at or above the 300% internal action-level target.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate to the Capital Management Manager if the ratio falls below 300% or moves over 10 points.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assessment is complete when the capital position summary is recorded with the as-of date.
generic.Evidence location: Capital adequacy assessment workpaper in the financial reporting repository.

steps.title: Open the actuarial modeling platform and pull the latest RBC model run
sop: Open the actuarial modeling platform (Prophet/MoSes/Axis/ResQ/Igloo) RBC run for the current quarter.
Locate the total adjusted capital (TAC) and authorized control level (ACL) outputs.
Done when TAC and ACL values are pulled for the current quarter-end run.
verify: Confirm TAC and ACL values match the model run's output screen.
Pass when both figures are captured with the correct run date.

steps.title: Calculate the RBC ratio and compare to the 300% target
sop: In the workpaper, divide TAC by ACL to compute the RBC ratio.
Compare the result to the 300% internal action-level target.
Done when the RBC ratio is calculated and compared to target.
verify: Recompute TAC/ACL independently and match to the recorded ratio.
Pass when the ratio ties out and the target comparison is noted.

steps.title: Pull the prior quarter's filed solvency ratio from the financial reporting repository
sop: Open the financial reporting repository and locate the prior quarter's filed RBC ratio.
Enter the prior ratio alongside the current ratio in the workpaper.
Done when the prior quarter ratio is recorded next to the current ratio.
verify: Confirm the prior ratio matches the filed annual/quarterly statement.
Pass when the prior-period figure is sourced from the filed statement.

steps.title: Flag any ratio movement over 10 points
sop: Calculate the point change between current and prior quarter RBC ratios.
Flag the movement in the workpaper if it exceeds 10 points in either direction.
Done when the movement is calculated and flagged if over threshold.
verify: Confirm the point-change calculation and flag status.
Pass when any movement over 10 points is flagged with a note.

steps.title: Load the capital position summary into Oracle EPM
sop: Enter TAC, ACL, RBC ratio, and as-of date into the Oracle EPM capital reporting module.
Confirm the entry matches the workpaper figures.
Done when the summary is loaded into Oracle EPM.
verify: Compare the Oracle EPM entry to the workpaper.
Pass when figures match with no transcription error.

steps.title: Record the assessment in the capital adequacy assessment workpaper
sop: Save the finalized workpaper with the as-of date and model run version noted.
File the workpaper in the financial reporting repository.
Done when the workpaper is saved with as-of date and filed.
verify: Open the filed workpaper and confirm the as-of date and version are present.
Pass when the workpaper is retrievable with the correct as-of date.

steps.title: Route the assessment to the Capital Management Manager for review
sop: Send the completed capital position assessment to the Capital Management Manager.
Address any question raised on the calculation or flagged movement.
Done when the Capital Management Manager acknowledges the assessment.
verify: Confirm acknowledgment is recorded (email or sign-off note) from the Capital Management Manager.
Pass when acknowledgment is on file.

generic.Defined scope/population: Available and required (RBC) capital for every active legal entity in the group structure.
generic.In-scope period: Current quarter/annual cycle used for the actuarial model run being compiled.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Legal entity code, TAC, ACL RBC, jurisdiction of domicile, and reporting currency populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Entity count in the compiled dataset matches the count of active legal entities in the group structure.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Compiled legal-entity capital dataset retained with the model run version and as-of date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any entity where available capital does not tie to statutory surplus logged with the variance amount.
generic.Test population: The full compiled legal-entity capital dataset for the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every active legal entity has a populated TAC, ACL, and reconciled surplus figure with zero unresolved variances.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate unreconciled entities to the Capital Management Manager before the dataset is finalized.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Dataset is complete when every active legal entity is populated and reconciled.
generic.Evidence location: Enterprise data warehouse/lakehouse capital compilation dataset.

steps.title: Extract TAC and ACL by legal entity from the actuarial model output
sop: Open the actuarial modeling platform and export the by-entity RBC results.
Load TAC and ACL figures for each legal entity into the compilation dataset.
Done when TAC and ACL are extracted for every entity in the model run.
verify: Spot-check extracted figures against the model's entity-level output screen.
Pass when extracted values match the model output for a sample of entities.

steps.title: Reconcile each entity's available capital to statutory surplus in the general ledger
sop: Open the ERP/General ledger and pull statutory surplus by legal entity.
Compare each entity's available capital figure to its GL surplus balance.
Done when every entity's available capital ties to its GL surplus or a variance is noted.
verify: Recompute the tie-out for a sample of entities.
Pass when available capital equals GL surplus or the variance is explained.

steps.title: Tag each entity record with legal entity code, jurisdiction, and currency
sop: In the enterprise data warehouse dataset, add legal entity code, domicile jurisdiction, and reporting currency columns.
Populate the tags from the group's legal entity master list.
Done when every record carries entity code, jurisdiction, and currency.
verify: Check a sample of records against the legal entity master list.
Pass when tags match the master list with no blanks.

steps.title: Confirm the dataset covers every active legal entity
sop: Compare the compiled dataset's entity list to the group's active legal entity list.
Add or flag any missing entity for follow-up with the actuarial team.
Done when the dataset's entity count matches the active legal entity count.
verify: Count records in the dataset and compare to the active entity list count.
Pass when the counts match exactly.

steps.title: Save the compiled dataset to the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Save the finalized by-entity capital dataset with the current cycle's as-of date.
Version-tag the file with the model run reference.
Done when the dataset is saved with as-of date and version tag.
verify: Retrieve the saved dataset and confirm the as-of date and version tag are present.
Pass when the file is retrievable with correct tags.

steps.title: Route the compiled dataset to the Capital Management Manager
sop: Send the finalized dataset to the Capital Management Manager for review.
Resolve any question on entity coverage or reconciliation before sign-off.
Done when the Capital Management Manager acknowledges the dataset.
verify: Confirm acknowledgment is logged.
Pass when sign-off is on file.

generic.Defined scope/population: The current-cycle actual capital position compared to the board-approved capital plan.
generic.In-scope period: Current reporting cycle versus the approved capital plan for the same period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Variance amount, materiality threshold, root cause, and recommended response populated in the memo.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Variance amount recalculated from Oracle EPM ties to the amount cited in the escalation memo.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Escalation memo retained in the financial reporting repository with the variance calculation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each variance exceeding the materiality threshold logged with root cause and recommended response.
generic.Test population: All variances between actual and planned capital position for the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Variance exceeds the internal materiality threshold, triggering mandatory escalation.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate to the Chief Financial Officer and Capital Management Manager before the next committee meeting.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Escalation is complete when the memo is routed and acknowledged before the next committee meeting.
generic.Evidence location: Financial reporting repository, escalation memo archive.

steps.title: Pull actual and planned capital position from Oracle EPM
sop: Open Oracle EPM and retrieve the current actual capital position report.
Retrieve the approved capital plan figures for the same period.
Done when both actual and planned figures are extracted.
verify: Confirm the extracted figures match the Oracle EPM report screen.
Pass when actual and planned values are captured accurately.

steps.title: Calculate the variance and compare to the materiality threshold
sop: Subtract the planned figure from the actual figure to compute the variance.
Compare the variance to the internal materiality threshold.
Done when the variance is calculated and flagged if it exceeds the threshold.
verify: Recompute the variance independently.
Pass when the recomputed variance matches and the threshold comparison is correct.

steps.title: Document the root cause of each material deviation
sop: Investigate the driver of the flagged variance (e.g., loss development, market value decline).
Record the root cause narrative in the escalation workpaper.
Done when a root cause is documented for every material deviation.
verify: Review the root cause narrative for completeness against the variance driver.
Pass when the narrative clearly identifies a specific driver.

steps.title: Draft the escalation memo in the financial reporting repository
sop: Draft the memo naming the deviation amount, driver, and recommended response.
Save the draft to the financial reporting repository.
Done when the memo draft is saved with all required elements.
verify: Check the memo contains amount, driver, and recommended response.
Pass when all three elements are present in the draft.

steps.title: Route the escalation memo to the Capital Management Manager and CFO
sop: Send the finalized memo to the Capital Management Manager and Chief Financial Officer.
Request acknowledgment ahead of the next committee meeting.
Done when the memo is sent to both recipients before the meeting.
verify: Confirm the send timestamp is before the next committee meeting date.
Pass when the memo reaches both recipients on time.

steps.title: Obtain CFO acknowledgment of the escalation
sop: Review the escalation memo and the recommended response.
Record acknowledgment (reply, sign-off, or meeting note).
Done when CFO acknowledgment is captured.
verify: Confirm acknowledgment is on file with a date.
Pass when acknowledgment is documented before the committee meeting.

generic.Defined scope/population: The aggregated economic capital requirement across insurance, market, credit, and operational risk modules.
generic.In-scope period: Current economic capital model run cycle (typically annual or per capital plan cycle).
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Economic capital by risk module, aggregated total, correlation matrix version, and confidence level populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sum of risk-module economic capital after diversification ties to the model's total aggregated output.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Capital adequacy workpaper retained with model run date and assumption version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any module output outside the expected range from the prior cycle logged with explanation.
generic.Test population: The full economic capital model run across all four risk modules for the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Model assumptions (correlation matrix, confidence level) match the version on file in the model governance repository.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate to the Capital Management Manager and Risk Analyst if assumptions do not match the approved version.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Complete when the requirement is quantified by risk category with the approved model version referenced.
generic.Evidence location: Model governance repository and capital adequacy workpaper.

steps.title: Run the internal economic capital model across all four risk modules
sop: Open the actuarial modeling platform and launch the economic capital model run.
Confirm the insurance, market, credit, and operational risk modules are all included.
Done when the model run completes with output for all four modules.
verify: Check the run log confirms all four modules executed.
Pass when output exists for each of the four risk modules.

steps.title: Confirm model assumptions match the model governance repository version
sop: Open the model governance repository and locate the approved correlation matrix and confidence level.
Compare these to the assumptions used in the current model run.
Done when assumptions are confirmed to match the approved version.
verify: Cross-check the run configuration against the governance repository record.
Pass when no discrepancy is found between run and approved assumptions.

steps.title: Compare aggregated economic capital to the regulatory RBC requirement
sop: Pull the aggregated economic capital total from the model output.
Compare it to the regulatory RBC requirement and note the more binding constraint.
Done when the binding constraint is identified and noted.
verify: Recheck which figure is larger and confirm the note matches.
Pass when the more binding constraint is correctly identified.

steps.title: Document the requirement by risk category in the workpaper
sop: Enter economic capital by risk module into the capital adequacy workpaper.
Save the workpaper in the enterprise data warehouse/lakehouse.
Done when all four risk-module figures are documented in the workpaper.
verify: Confirm each risk module's figure appears in the workpaper.
Pass when all four modules are represented with matching values.

steps.title: Route the workpaper to the Capital Management Manager and Risk Analyst
sop: Send the completed workpaper to the Capital Management Manager and Risk Analyst for review.
Address any question on module assumptions before finalizing.
Done when both reviewers acknowledge the workpaper.
verify: Confirm acknowledgment from both reviewers is on file.
Pass when sign-off is recorded from the Capital Management Manager.

steps.title: Archive the finalized workpaper with the model version reference
sop: File the signed-off workpaper in the model governance repository.
Tag the file with the model run version and as-of date.
Done when the workpaper is archived with version and date tags.
verify: Retrieve the archived file and confirm tags are present.
Pass when the file is retrievable with correct version and date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Actual surplus and RBC ratio for the current month compared to the capital plan target.
generic.In-scope period: Current calendar month, compared against the monthly capital plan target.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Actual surplus, actual RBC ratio, plan target, and variance populated in the monthly tracker.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Actual surplus in the tracker ties to the Oracle EPM general ledger surplus balance for the month.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Monthly capital tracker retained with the month-end date and update timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any breach of the internal tolerance band logged with the driver of movement.
generic.Test population: The current month's capital tracker entry and its variance calculation.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Variance stays within the internal tolerance band, or a breach is flagged with a driver explanation.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate a tolerance-band breach to the Capital Management Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Complete when the monthly comparison is recorded and distributed to the team.

steps.title: Update the monthly capital tracker with actual surplus and RBC ratio
sop: Open Oracle EPM and pull the current month's actual surplus and RBC ratio.
Enter the figures into the monthly capital tracker alongside the plan target.
Done when actual, plan, and RBC ratio are entered for the month.
verify: Confirm entered figures match the Oracle EPM report.
Pass when the tracker figures tie to the source report.

steps.title: Calculate the variance and check the tolerance band
sop: Calculate the variance between actual and planned capital position.
Compare the variance to the internal tolerance band and flag any breach.
Done when the variance is calculated and any breach is flagged.
verify: Recompute the variance and confirm the flag status.
Pass when the flag correctly reflects whether the tolerance band was breached.

steps.title: Note the drivers of the monthly movement
sop: Identify the primary drivers of the month's capital movement (earnings, market value, dividend, capital raise).
Record the drivers next to the variance in the tracker.
Done when drivers are documented for the month's movement.
verify: Confirm the recorded drivers are consistent with the general ledger activity for the month.
Pass when drivers align with GL entries for the period.

steps.title: Save the updated tracker in the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Save the updated monthly tracker with the month-end date.
Confirm the file version reflects the latest update.
Done when the tracker is saved with the correct month-end date.
verify: Open the saved file and confirm the date and figures are current.
Pass when the file reflects the current month's data.

steps.title: Distribute the monthly capital position summary to the team
sop: Prepare the summary email or report from the updated tracker.
Distribute to the capital management team distribution list.
Done when the summary is distributed to the team.
verify: Confirm the distribution was sent and received.
Pass when the summary reaches all listed recipients.

steps.title: Confirm Capital Management Manager review of any flagged breach
sop: Review any tolerance-band breach flagged for the month.
Confirm or request further action on the driver identified.
Done when the Capital Management Manager reviews the flagged item.
verify: Confirm review is logged.
Pass when a response or acknowledgment is on file for any flagged breach.

generic.Defined scope/population: The finalized capital management plan and its board/finance committee approval record.
generic.In-scope period: Current planning cycle's capital management plan, approved ahead of the scheduled board meeting.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Plan version, board portal upload date, vote outcome, and any conditions populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Board portal upload date is at least five business days before the meeting date.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed approval record retained with the meeting date and plan version in the governance archive.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any condition attached to the approval logged against the plan record.
generic.Test population: The current cycle's board/finance committee approval record for the capital management plan.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Plan uploaded at least five business days before the meeting and approval recorded with no unresolved condition.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate to the Head of Capital Management if the lead-time or CFO approval is missing before upload.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Complete when the signed approval record is filed against the current plan.

steps.title: Load the finalized capital management plan to the board portal
sop: Confirm the plan version is CFO-approved before upload.
Upload the plan to the board portal at least five business days before the meeting.
Done when the plan is uploaded within the required lead time.
verify: Check the board portal upload timestamp against the meeting date.
Pass when the upload is five or more business days ahead.

steps.title: Confirm the plan includes sources, deployment options, and target ratios
sop: Review the uploaded plan for capital sources, deployment options, and target ratio sections.
Confirm CFO sign-off is attached to the plan version.
Done when all required sections and CFO sign-off are confirmed present.
verify: Check the plan document for each required section.
Pass when sources, deployment options, targets, and CFO sign-off are all present.

steps.title: Present the plan at the board or finance committee meeting
sop: Present the plan to the board or finance committee.
Field questions and note any requested modification.
Done when the plan has been presented for a vote.
verify: Confirm the meeting minutes reflect the presentation.
Pass when minutes show the plan was presented.

steps.title: Record the board or finance committee vote and conditions
sop: Record the vote outcome (approved, approved with conditions, deferred).
Document any condition attached to the approval.
Done when the vote outcome and conditions are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded vote to the official meeting minutes.
Pass when the recorded outcome matches the minutes.

steps.title: Obtain Head of Capital Management confirmation of the approval
sop: Review the recorded vote and any conditions.
Confirm the approval is accurately captured before filing.
Done when the Head of Capital Management confirms the record.
verify: Confirm sign-off from the Head of Capital Management is on file.
Pass when confirmation is documented.

steps.title: File the signed approval record in the governance archive
sop: Save the signed approval record with the capital management plan.
Tag the file with the meeting date and plan version.
Done when the record is filed in the governance archive.
verify: Retrieve the filed record and confirm tags are present.
Pass when the record is retrievable with correct tags.

generic.Defined scope/population: The draft capital management plan covering sources/uses, target ratios, and stress sensitivity for the planning horizon.
generic.In-scope period: The upcoming planning horizon covered by the capital management plan (multi-year).
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Capital sources/uses breakdown, target RBC ratio range, liquidity buffer, and stress sensitivity summary populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sum of capital sources equals sum of capital uses in the draft plan.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Draft plan retained in the financial reporting repository with a draft version number.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any section left incomplete at circulation logged as an open item for follow-up.
generic.Test population: The current draft capital management plan submitted for committee review.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: All four required sections (sources/uses, target ratio, liquidity buffer, stress sensitivity) are present and populated.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate an incomplete section to the FP&A Manager before committee submission.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Complete when the draft plan is ready with all sections and reviewed before committee submission.
generic.Evidence location: Financial reporting repository draft plan folder.

steps.title: Draft the capital sources and uses section in Oracle EPM
sop: Open Oracle EPM and build the sources section covering earnings, reinsurance, debt, and equity.
Build the corresponding uses section for the planning horizon.
Done when sources and uses sections are drafted and balance.
verify: Confirm total sources equal total uses.
Pass when the sources and uses sections tie out.

steps.title: Set the target RBC ratio range and liquidity buffer
sop: Enter the target RBC ratio range for the planning horizon in the plan document.
Enter the minimum liquidity buffer requirement.
Done when both the target ratio range and liquidity buffer are set.
verify: Compare the entered range and buffer to the prior approved plan for consistency.
Pass when the figures are consistent with policy or a rationale is noted for any change.

steps.title: Pull the stress-scenario capital sensitivity summary from the latest stress test run
sop: Open the actuarial modeling platform and retrieve the latest stress test output.
Summarize the capital sensitivity results into the plan's stress summary section.
Done when the stress sensitivity summary is included in the draft plan.
verify: Confirm the summary figures match the actuarial platform's stress test output.
Pass when the figures tie to the source stress test run.

steps.title: Assemble the complete draft plan in the financial reporting repository
sop: Combine the sources/uses, target ratios, liquidity buffer, and stress summary into one draft document.
Save the draft to the financial reporting repository.
Done when the complete draft is saved.
verify: Open the saved draft and confirm all four sections are present.
Pass when no section is missing from the assembled draft.

steps.title: Circulate the draft to FP&A Manager for review
sop: Send the draft plan to the FP&A Manager for review.
Request comments before the committee submission deadline.
Done when the draft is circulated with a review deadline.
verify: Confirm the FP&A Manager acknowledges receipt.
Pass when acknowledgment is received before the deadline.

steps.title: Incorporate FP&A Manager feedback into the draft
sop: Review comments returned by the FP&A Manager.
Update the draft plan to address the feedback.
Done when feedback is incorporated or a rationale is noted for declining it.
verify: Compare the updated draft to the feedback comments.
Pass when each comment is addressed or explained.

steps.title: Finalize the draft for committee submission
sop: Confirm all sections are complete and feedback incorporated.
Save the final draft version for committee submission.
Done when the draft plan is ready for committee submission.
verify: Review the final draft against the plan checklist.
Pass when all checklist items are satisfied.

generic.Defined scope/population: The capital adequacy assessment deck presented to the board finance committee for the current cycle.
generic.In-scope period: Current reporting cycle's capital adequacy assessment presented at the scheduled committee meeting.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Current RBC ratio, prior-period trend, stress test outcomes, and meeting date populated in the deck.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: RBC ratio and trend figures in the deck tie to the underlying capital adequacy assessment workpaper.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Presented deck and meeting minutes retained with the meeting date in the board materials archive.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Committee follow-up actions logged with an owner and due date.
generic.Test population: The presented deck and the meeting minutes from the current cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Deck uploaded to the board portal ahead of the meeting with all required content present.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate any missing deck content to the CFO before the meeting.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Complete when the presentation is delivered with minutes and follow-up actions recorded.

steps.title: Finalize and upload the capital adequacy deck to the board portal
sop: Confirm the deck includes current RBC ratio, trend versus prior periods, and stress test outcomes.
Upload the finalized deck to the board portal ahead of the meeting.
Done when the deck is uploaded with all required content.
verify: Review the uploaded deck for the three required content elements.
Pass when RBC ratio, trend, and stress outcomes are all present.

steps.title: Confirm deck figures tie to the capital adequacy workpaper
sop: Compare deck RBC figures to the source capital adequacy assessment workpaper.
Correct any discrepancy before the meeting.
Done when deck figures match the source workpaper.
verify: Spot-check two figures in the deck against the workpaper.
Pass when figures match exactly.

steps.title: Present the assessment to the board finance committee
sop: Present the deck to the board finance committee.
Field questions from committee members.
Done when the presentation is delivered.
verify: Confirm the meeting occurred with the presentation on the agenda.
Pass when the agenda and attendance confirm delivery.

steps.title: Record committee questions and follow-up actions
sop: Note each question raised and any follow-up action requested.
Assign an owner and due date to each follow-up action.
Done when all questions and follow-ups are recorded with an owner.
verify: Review the recorded follow-ups against the meeting discussion.
Pass when every raised item has a recorded follow-up or owner.

steps.title: Obtain CFO review of the minutes and follow-up log
sop: Review the meeting minutes and follow-up action log.
Confirm accuracy before filing.
Done when the CFO confirms the minutes and follow-ups are accurate.
verify: Confirm CFO sign-off is on file.
Pass when sign-off is recorded.

steps.title: File the deck and minutes in the board materials archive
sop: Save the presented deck and finalized minutes to the board materials archive.
Tag both with the meeting date.
Done when both documents are archived with the meeting date.
verify: Retrieve the archived documents and confirm the meeting date tag.
Pass when both files are retrievable with correct tags.

generic.Defined scope/population: Multi-year capital position projections under base and at least one adverse scenario for the full planning horizon.
generic.In-scope period: The full multi-year planning horizon (typically 3-5 years) covered by the projection.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Projected RBC ratio, surplus, and key assumptions populated for every projected year.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Base-case projected RBC ratio for year one ties to the current capital adequacy assessment starting point.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Projection model output retained in the enterprise data warehouse with the scenario set and as-of date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any projected year where base-case RBC ratio falls below the action-level trigger logged for follow-up.
generic.Test population: Every projected year in the base and adverse scenario projections.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Base-case projected RBC ratio stays above the internal action-level trigger in every projected year.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate to the Capital Management Manager if any base-case year breaches the action-level trigger.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Complete when base and stress-scenario projections are produced across the full horizon.
generic.Evidence location: Oracle EPM multi-year capital projection model.

steps.title: Build the multi-year capital projection under the base business plan scenario
sop: Open Oracle EPM and set up the base-case multi-year projection using the current business plan.
Run the projection for each year of the planning horizon.
Done when base-case RBC ratio and surplus are projected for every year.
verify: Confirm output exists for every year of the horizon.
Pass when no year is missing from the base-case projection.

steps.title: Run the projection under an adverse scenario
sop: Configure at least one adverse scenario (cat event, reserve strengthening, or market shock) in the actuarial modeling platform.
Run the projection under the adverse scenario for the same horizon.
Done when the adverse-scenario projection is produced for the full horizon.
verify: Confirm adverse-scenario output covers the same years as the base case.
Pass when both scenarios cover the identical planning horizon.

steps.title: Confirm base-case RBC ratio stays above the action-level trigger
sop: Compare the projected RBC ratio for each base-case year to the internal action-level trigger.
Flag any year falling below the trigger.
Done when every year is checked against the trigger.
verify: Recheck the lowest projected year's ratio against the trigger.
Pass when the lowest year still clears the trigger or is flagged.

steps.title: Document key assumptions driving the projection
sop: Record premium growth, loss ratio, and investment return assumptions used in the projection.
Save the assumptions alongside the projection output in the enterprise data warehouse.
Done when all key assumptions are documented.
verify: Confirm the documented assumptions match the values used in the model run.
Pass when assumptions in the record match the model configuration.

steps.title: Route the projection to the Capital Management Manager and FP&A Manager
sop: Send the base and adverse scenario projections to the Capital Management Manager and FP&A Manager.
Address any question on assumptions before finalizing.
Done when both reviewers acknowledge the projection.
verify: Confirm acknowledgment from both reviewers.
Pass when sign-off is on file from the Capital Management Manager.

steps.title: Save the finalized projections with the as-of date
sop: Save the finalized base and adverse scenario projections with the current as-of date.
Tag the file with the scenario set used.
Done when projections are saved with as-of date and scenario tags.
verify: Retrieve the saved file and confirm tags are present.
Pass when the file is retrievable with correct as-of date and scenario tags.

generic.Defined scope/population: The RBC report and supporting schedules filed with the lead-state regulator for the entity's line of business.
generic.In-scope period: Current annual/quarterly RBC filing cycle per NAIC instructions.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Lead-state regulator name, filing due date, RBC schedules, and submission confirmation populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: RBC report figures tie to the ERP/General ledger statutory financial data used to prepare the filing.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Submission confirmation retained in the regulatory filing tracker with the submission date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any discrepancy between tracker due date and NAIC filing deadline logged and corrected before submission.
generic.Test population: The current cycle's RBC filing and its tracker record.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Filing submitted on or before the statutory due date with a confirmation receipt retained.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate to the Statutory Reporting Manager if the due date is at risk of being missed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Complete when the filing is submitted and the confirmation receipt is retained.

steps.title: Prepare the RBC report and supporting schedules per NAIC instructions
sop: Pull statutory financial data from the ERP/General ledger for the entity's line of business.
Prepare the RBC report and schedules per the current NAIC RBC instructions.
Done when the report and schedules are prepared.
verify: Compare report figures to the ERP/GL source data.
Pass when figures tie to the general ledger.

steps.title: Confirm the lead-state regulator and due date on the tracker
sop: Open the regulatory filing/issue tracker and verify the lead-state regulator field.
Verify the filing due date matches the NAIC statutory deadline.
Done when regulator and due date are confirmed correct.
verify: Cross-check the tracker entry against the NAIC filing calendar.
